intended_object: The singular simplicial set Sing(X) of a topological space X, seen as the ambient simplicial set of the pair (X, {x}) (from the docstring).
explanation: TopPair.toSSetPair applies Mathlib's singular functor TopCat.toSSet to the inclusion of the subspace into the space. The library lemma `toSSetPair_obj_right` states, and proves by rfl, that the `.right` part is `TopCat.toSSet.obj P.fst`. So `pairSSet x` is definitionally `TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of X)`, which is exactly Sing(X). The base point x only selects which pair the space is seen as the ambient part of; it does not change the simplicial set. The definition works for an arbitrary topological space, which is the natural generality. It is a convenience abbreviation that reuses Mathlib's construction, and it agrees with the intended object on every input.
